headline: Full 8-Ball Pool in pure vanilla JavaScript with realistic spin physics
text:
Built a full 8-Ball Pool sim in a single HTML file. Cue ball spin control, called pockets, 3 AI tiers, and zero downloads/ads.

Loads in 0.1s in your browser:
https://kreeda.games/break-room/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second clean looping screen recording showing a high-draw backspin shot into the corner pocket with the interactive cue spin pad visible.
